The primary subject is a male mallard (drake) in the foreground right, standing with bright orange webbed feet visible. It features the characteristic iridescent green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, and grey body. A second duck, likely a female or eclipse male, is in the foreground left, preening its back feathers, showing brown mottled plumage and orange feet. A third duck, a female mallard, is swimming in the background water, partially out of focus.
